title: Red Tandoori Curry
method: Cut chicken and marinate with yoghurt, 1.5 tbsp tandoori spice, coriander powder, and 1 tsp garlic puree for 3 hours.
Skewer chicken and grill under high heat until golden.
Infuse oil with cloves for 2 minutes, then discard cloves.
Caramelise chopped onions with 1/2 tsp brown sugar for 15-20 minutes.
Add ginger and garlic puree; fry 2 minutes.
Add dry spices, tomato puree, mango chutney, and brown sugar; fry 2 minutes.
Add creamed tomatoes and chicken stock; simmer 10-15 minutes.
Fold in grilled chicken, simmer 5 minutes, and finish with fresh coriander.
